entry_points.text: Block entries take device block size mode to obtain entries, sync read, readahead, and boundary flush when dirty; folio entries mark dirtiness, invalidate locked ranges, and build empty chains with state.

Buffered write gets locked folio and prepares via begin, releasing on failure; contiguous write fills gap then delegates; mkwrite locks faulted folio, validates, prepares, commits, dirties and waits; expand writes zero length at target; full read chains async reads and completes or records errors.

exports.text: Block read services provide cache lookup by device block and size, sync read ensuring validity, opportunistic readahead with prompt release, and conditional nonblocking start only when not uptodate and unlocked.

Dirtying and write helpers cover single and folio wide marking with inode propagation, metadata association, cgroup attribution, boundary flush, folio begin via mapping callback, and partial uptodate probing.
Buffer lifecycle covers descriptor allocation and release, per folio chain creation, data pointer setup, empty chains with initial state, range invalidation and reclamation attempts.

Per CPU cache and reference helpers cover global and local draining, presence probing, null tolerant release, ordered decrement, sleepable lock and wait with nonblocking attempts, and alias invalidation for ranges and single blocks.

hazards.text: Zero ref release, freeing with association, overflowing ranges, data beyond folio, unaligned or out of range sizes warn or fail; reclaim forbids unlocked or writeback folios and busy members; forget clears dirty association before release with ordered decrement.

Residency pins folios so install skips when caching disabled and bypasses isolated CPUs; beyond size cleaned not written, late dirtiness left for later, size races are IO errors, nonblocking redirty throttled above, async told by absent async state.
Cross dossier helpers for checks, locks, atomics, percpu, preempt, folio cache, batches, math, barriers, flush, errors and isolation live elsewhere; not described here.

invariants.text: Submit needs locked mapped buffer without delay or unwritten; rewrite clears write error once; IO scales block by size, binds completion to buffer, guards device end, associates writeback and crypto unless unmapped; cgroup accounting needs writeback, ignores offline, accumulates on match with leading and trailing vote candidates.
Lookup hits per CPU small set with move to front and ref, else slow path marks access and installs; install rotates set, retains with extra ref and releases displaced.

Folio chains use uniform size and descending offsets, circular links and unmapped init, then sequential numbering from folio position with mapped only inside capacity; growth reuses compatible chains else reclaims or allocates under exclusion and validates size and alignment.

Dirtying warns if invalid, fast paths already dirty, propagates buffer to folio to inode once and batch marks under exclusion; metadata claims once tolerating duplicates; invalidation needs locked folio, drops fully covered, clears mapped; busy means referenced dirty or locked and blocks reclaim.

Slow read serializes, returns if valid else reads and waits, releasing on failure; wrappers use blocking matched no fail modes; pressure sampled rate limited against max; boundary writes next block only if dirty then drops ref.

Create needs locked folio and reuses ring; zeroing clears new overlaps when folio not uptodate; write end truncates torn shorts, flushes, commits prefix, extends size under lock then dirties inode; gaps zero filled with throttle and signal abort; fresh blocks invalidate aliases.

locks.text: Buffer locking is sleepable with fast try and blocking fallback; wait sleeps only when locked; conditional readahead runs only when not valid and trylock succeeds.

Per CPU sets use interrupt or preempt exclusion by config, require irqs on, bypass isolated or disabled caches; folio lock pins buffers for create begin commit and read while buffer locks serialize IO; invalidation uses folio lock; nonblocking writeback trylocks and redirties on contention.

Metadata exclusion serializes claim and drain, buffer exclusion serializes discard and slow read checks; size store uses seqcount with preempt disable on narrow MP, preempt disable on narrow preemptible, else release ordering.

state_machines.text: Residency installs new entries at front with rotation and ref retention, promotes hits, drains globally or locally with release.

Full writeback ensures buffers, cleans beyond EOF, maps, clears delay new, invalidates aliases, locks, moves dirty to async, starts writeback, submits with completion, unlocks and records errors; extent handling rejects short maps and covers hole delay unwritten mapped with new and block computation; begin creates buffers, inherits outside, maps inside, zeroes fresh partials, reads boundaries and waits; commit gains uptodate dirty inside, clears new, promotes folio only if outside clean.

Acquisition goes hit to reuse else growth and slow lookup with retry; submit needs locked mapped and binds completion with guard; dirty moves valid to buffer to folio to inode, invalidation reverses mapping and optionally detaches.

structs.text: Per CPU residency holds fixed 16 entry array of buffer pointers, one per CPU, all initially empty.

Buffers form circular ring from folio via next links, uniform size from block bits, each with device, block number, size and mapped new dirty uptodate delay unwritten request async flags; data encodes offset directly for highmem else base plus offset; discard clears mapped new request delay unwritten.
